styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale stone grey #EDEBE8 for desk and cutaway screens, mist blue #E9F2FB for the twin comparison panel; one flat colour field per shot, no gradients or random interiors
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool high-key studio light, large soft frontal key from the upper left with a white fill card, gentle contact shadows only, controlled speculars limited to metal parts, one consistent light direction per shot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white-veined marble desktop #EDEBE8, matte cool-white studio steps #F3F5F8, large-format stone wall #E4E7EA
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; all source marketing copy stripped, in-image wording left as blank bars, empty caption slots and empty table cells to be typeset in post
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside circles, accent blue #2E7BD6 only, one icon row per screen, no filled or shaded glyphs
styleLock.presentationRules: compact rounded rectangular brick shown at one stable scale and one stable three-quarter read across the set, paired cable always coiled the same way, port opening and folding prongs visible whenever the geometry allows
noDrift: no numbers, units, badges or seals rendered inside the frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean premium tech accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale stone grey #EDEBE8, mist blue panel #E9F2FB and one cool accent blue #2E7BD6 with graphite text #2D3238; neutral-cool high-key studio lighting, large soft frontal key from the upper left with a white fill card, gentle contact shadows, controlled speculars only on metal; modern geometric sans-serif with all marketing copy removed and every label left as a blank bar or empty cell; thin single-weight circular line icons in accent blue only; stable rounded rectangular brick scale and three-quarter read; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no numbers or certification seals inside the frame.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清主体与配线，抢点击

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with a white fill card, tight soft contact shadow, speculars only on the metal prongs and connector shells
shots.background: seamless pure white #FFFFFF with a faint pale stone falloff #EDEBE8 at the base
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, even clean margin around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, with its matching cable laid in the lower foreground. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The unit stands upright at a straight-on eye-level view turned a slight 3/4 toward camera, full silhouette visible and never clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio light with a soft front-left key and a white fill card, a tight soft contact shadow grounding the unit, controlled speculars limited to the metal prongs and the connector shells. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with a faint pale stone falloff #EDEBE8 at the base. No props except the matching cable. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace around it. Square 1:1, 2K, catalog-grade electronics imaging with true straight edges. Negative: no brand marks or wordmarks, no text of any kind, no wattage or current figures, no numeric labels, no hands, no floating product without a contact shadow, no bent prongs or warped edges, no gradient background, no duplicated connector heads.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底立体渲染，主机立于右侧、两条同色配线接头横卧前景；002 主机插在桌面白色排插上，配线弧形连至右侧开盖笔记本，蓝色能量流动标记沿线缆排布，左上蓝色标题带、左下圆形图标角标；003 左右双栏对照，两台同型开盖笔记本＋两条半圆刻度盘与大号读数；004 墙面插座内构剖视、蓝光内芯，上方一排四个圆形线性图标；005 主机与盘绕配线居前，身后扇形叠放多台设备屏幕，底部一排七个线性设备图标；006 配线剖面：接头外壳剖开露出内板、线身剥开露出编织层与导体端头，左上两个圆形细节泡、右下三个圆形徽标；007 一立一平两台主机置白色台阶，虚线尺寸括号，底部三联方格小图（插脚折收／盘绕配线／接口孔）。品类判定依据：图示为带折叠插脚的 USB-C 供电头＋同规格 C-to-C 配线的充电套装，兼容诉求横跨手机／平板／笔电／手表／相机，属通用数码充电附件而非整机配件，故判 手机数码／数码配件，未按原站类目挂到电脑办公。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与店铺字样、全部机型名称与图标旁的机种文字、瓦数与电流与时长与容量与尺寸等全部数字主张、标题带与角标原句、平台徽章与评分样式、笔记本与手机屏幕上可辨识的壁纸与界面；兼容清单改为空白适配表、读数改为空白刻度盘与空标签框、尺寸与图标文字改为空白槽位，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
